Admin & MC Trade Guide

Greater Akron Chamber · Card Scanner · version 0.4.12

For the person who runs the scanner and does the MC Trade import. Reviewing cards: Reviewer Start Here. Demo video.

Not yet checked against MC Trade. The import file has not been tested with MC Trade's real import template. Import 2 rows first and check them in MC Trade before importing the rest.

1. Install (once)

  1. Run GAC-Card-Scanner-Setup.exe (Windows) or open the .dmg (Mac).
  2. Open GAC Card Scanner. First-time setup creates the first admin (on the scanner computer only).
  3. Admin → Reviewers: add one account per person.

2. Every day

  • Keep GAC Card Scanner open while people work.
  • AI check (optional): Admin → Settings → AI helper → Start. Scanning works without it.
  • Scan with phone: Scan cards → More. Same office Wi-Fi.
More: backups
  • Automatic every night at 02:30. The last 7 are kept in backups/.
  • Another disk: start with GAC_BACKUP_DIR=<folder>.
  • Restore: stop the scanner, run scripts/restore_backup.sh <file>, type YES.

3. Who may do what

Who May export
Reviewer Approved cards of their own batch
Admin Any batch, or all batches

Only admins can Confirm a blocked field. Open the card, compare with the photo, press Confirm in the red box and give a reason.

Needs admin: reviewers flag blocked cards for you. Turn on Needs admin in the Review queue to list them.

4. Export

  1. Export. Pick the batch.
  2. Preview shows the rows and what is left out.
  3. Export → Save.

After saving, the Next steps box names the ONE file to import (IMPORT-ME_…xlsx, in your Downloads). Files named NOT-FOR-IMPORT_… are for reading.

The READ-ME starts with one line, e.g. Ready to import: 3 rows (2 clean, 1 to check). The same numbers show on the Export page, the batch list, the Save dialog, the summary and the dry run.

More: why a card is left out

The Export page says why in one line. The Left-out list names each card.

  • Already exported: this person (same email, or same name and company) was in an earlier IMPORT-ME file. Leaving them out avoids a duplicate in MC Trade.
  • Edited after export, so it is not in this file unless an admin includes it. Tick Include anyway in the Save dialog to send it again.
  • Waiting for admin: a reviewer pressed Needs admin.
  • A contacts list (CSV) is not an MC Trade import. It never marks a card as sent.
  • Nothing new to import: no file is made.

5. MC Trade import: first time

  1. MC Trade Admin → Manage Codes: create CardScan-Pilot.
  2. MC Trade Import Profiles → Download Template. Upload it in Admin → Settings → MC Trade template.
  3. MC Trade Export All System Columns. Upload it in Admin → Settings → MC Trade contacts.
  4. Export → Look up in MC Trade (dry run). Fix every FIX FIRST row.
  5. Import 2 rows first. An import can't be undone.
  6. Import organizations, then individuals, then updates (separately).

The scanner never sends anything to MC Trade.

6. Settings and accounts

More: settings
Setting Default
AI double-check On when the AI helper runs
MC Trade code (AffCode1) CardScan-Pilot
Allow "update existing contact" Off. Turn on after one tested update import.
Phone format 330-555-0181
Delete photos after 30 days (never while pending)
Delete export copies after 30 days
  • Reset password also lifts a lock. Deactivate someone who left.
  • Locked out of every admin account: python -m app.admin reset-password <username>.

7. Archive, audit, removal

  • Archive batch (Review queue) hides it. Undo brings it back.
  • Admin → Audit log: who did what. Download as CSV.
  • Removal request: find the card in Review queue → All, then More → Delete… → Delete permanently. Remove them from MC Trade and old export files too.

8. Problems

GAC admin contact: ______________________ (name, phone or email)

Problem Do this
"AI check is off" Scanning still works. Settings → AI helper → Start.
Export blocked Open the listed cards and fix them.
"Something changed" on Save Someone edited a card. Check, then save again.
Phone can't connect Same Wi-Fi. Allow Private networks in the firewall.
Sign-in locked Admin → Reviewers → Reset password.
